name: Pelican
summary: Lists and controls game servers on a Pelican panel, and keeps a status message up to date.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: See game servers
permissions.description: Lists the game servers and their state.

extension_points.name: servers
extension_points.description: Lists game servers with state, CPU and RAM.

extension_points.name: Game servers
extension_points.description: Game servers and their state, beside the chat.

settings.label: Allow http
settings.help: Only for a panel on your own network.

settings.label: Servers
settings.help: Names or identifiers to show, separated by commas. Empty shows all.

settings.label: Control role
settings.help: Role id whose members may start and stop servers.

settings.label: Log channel
settings.help: Channel id for the power-action log. Power commands are off without it.

settings.label: Status channel
settings.help: Channel id for the status message. Empty means none.
